final:
I changed `_compute_grand_margin` in `pandas/core/reshape/pivot.py` to skip any column that isn't a key in a dict `aggfunc`. Before, it looked up `aggfunc[k]` for every column and raised `KeyError`. With the skip, `margins=True` should drop uncovered columns the same way the non-margins path does. I couldn't run anything here, so this is untested.

I only fixed the grand-margin computation. I didn't check whether other margin code, such as `_generate_marginal_results`, also assumes every column is covered by the dict. I also didn't add a test for the issue's examples.
